;Armed conflicts and attacks
*The [[United States Central Command]] announces that a U.S. airstrike in [[Ma'rib Governorate]], [[Yemen]], has killed [[Jamal Ahmad Mohammad Al Badawi]], who is believed to have masterminded the 2000 [[USS Cole bombing|USS ''Cole'' bombing]] that killed 17 American sailors. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/uss-cole-terrorism-jamel-ahmed-mohammed-ali-albadawi-alqaeda-yemen-911-killed-latest-a8712106.html (''The Independent'')]
*The [[Arakan Army (Kachin State)|Arakan Army]] attacks four police posts in [[Rakhine State]], [[Myanmar]], killing 13 policemen and injuring 9 others. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rakhine/rakhine-buddhist-army-kills-seven-in-independence-day-attack-on-police-posts-idUSKCN1OY0N0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents 
*[[Koszalin escape room fire]]
**Five 15-year-old girls are killed in a fire at an [[escape room]] in [[Koszalin]], [[Poland]]. [https://www.tvn24.pl/tvn24-news-in-english,157,m/tragic-fire-in-an-escape-room-in-koszalin-leaves-5-women-dead,897506.html (TVN24)]

;International relations
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**The [[Lima Group]] announces that from January 10, 2019, the government of [[Nicolás Maduro]] will no longer be recognized by the governments which compose the multilateral body. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/01/lima-group-won-recognise-maduro-government-venezuela-190104192331890.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Operation Inherent Resolve]], [[American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[United States Department of State]] announces that U.S. Special Representative for Syria Engagement [[James Franklin Jeffrey|James Jeffrey]] also assumes the position of Special Presidential Envoy for the [[International military intervention against ISIL|Global Coalition to Counter the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]], succeeding [[Brett McGurk]]. Separately, a State Department official says that there is no timeline for the withdrawal of U.S. troops from [[Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-usa-syria/u-s-says-no-timeline-for-syria-withdrawal-as-fighting-continues-idUSKCN1OY1I6 (Reuters)] [https://www.politico.com/story/2019/01/04/james-jeffrey-isis-envoy-1081890 (''Politico'')]
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**[[Communist Party of China|Chinese Communist Party]] [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China|general secretary]] [[Xi Jinping]] orders the country's [[People's Liberation Army|armed forces]] to be ready for battle following [[President of the Republic of China]] (Taiwan) [[Tsai Ing-wen]]'s call for international support to defend the self-ruled island’s democracy after rejecting of the [[one country, two systems]] principle. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/xi-jinping-tells-chinese-army-to-be-ready-for-battle/ar-BBRQL4n (''Newsweek'' via msn.com)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/2180830/taiwan-president-tsai-ing-wen-open-cross-strait-talks-has-some (''South China Morning Post'')]

;Law and crime
*A 51-year-old man is stabbed to death on a train in [[Borough of Guildford|Guildford]], [[Surrey]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/01/04/man-stabbed-death-board-train-near-horsley-surrey/ (''The Telegraph'')] 
*Three people are killed and four others are injured in a [[mass shootings in the United States|mass shooting]] in a bowling alley in [[Torrance, California]], [[United States]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/01/05/us/torrance-bowling-alley-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation|United States Special Counsel investigation]]
**[[United States federal judge|Chief United States District Judge]] [[Beryl A. Howell|Beryl Howell]] extends grand jury "17-1" for up to six months;  the original 18-month authorization  was set to expire Sunday. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/01/04/federal-judge-extends-mueller-grand-jury-by-another-six-months-report.html (CNBC)] 
*Sean Fitzgerald, 31, is [[List of killings by law enforcement officers in the United Kingdom|shot dead by police]] officers during a raid on a house in [[Coventry]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. Two 26-year-old men were arrested during the same raid, in connection with cannabis production.
